text: おうごんに　かがやく　たいもうと　９ほんの　ながい　しっぽを　もつ。
note: This draws on the nine-tailed fox (九尾の狐) of East Asian folklore, a fox spirit often described with golden fur.
claim: The nine-tailed fox (kyūbi no kitsune) is a fox spirit in East Asian folklore, often described as having golden fur.

check.quote: The nine-tailed fox (九尾狐) is a mythical fox entity originating from the mythology of China. ... [The doctrine] says that the celestial fox has nine tails and a golden color.
check.note: This draws on the nine-tailed fox (九尾の狐) of East Asian folklore, a fox spirit often described with golden fur.
